falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 low (4,158) would invalidate the 76% bottom pattern match, as that pattern required a higher low formation; this would confirm continuation lower not bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking at 38.57 then rapidly declining; sustained elevated VIX indicates panic escalation not capitulation, breaking the pattern's volatility signature

The August 2024 bottom coincided with spread normalization from inversion; deeper inversion signals worsening growth expectations, invalidating the cyclical recovery premise embedded in the 76% pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
